name: opencode-token-metrics
description: A live throughput meter for the OpenCode TUI, for V1 and V2. It renders beside the session prompt as a VU-style time-series of generation speed, with average, peak, trend, and time-to-first-token.

installation.summary: Add the npm package to your OpenCode plugins list (V2) or install it with the V1 plugin CLI.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

One package serves OpenCode V1 and V2. Install it the way your OpenCode version expects.

### V2 (2.x)

Add it to the `plugins` array in `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` or `opencode.json`:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": ["opencode-token-metrics"]
}
```

To pass options, put the plugin in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` instead:

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [
    { "package": "opencode-token-metrics", "options": { "vuColumns": 20, "vuScale": "fixed", "vuFullTps": 80 } }
  ]
}
```

`cli.json` is the CLI-side config, so options there reach the TUI plugin. Options written in `opencode.json` are delivered to server plugins and do not reach the TUI. Keep an entry in only one of the two files. Restart the TUI afterwards.

### V1 (1.x)

```bash
opencode plugin opencode-token-metrics -g
```

This installs the package from npm and adds it to `~/.config/opencode/tui.json`. TUI plugins belong in `tui.json`, not `opencode.json`.

Manual setup:

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": ["opencode-token-metrics"]
}
```

usage.markdown:
## Usage

Once installed, the meter renders beside the OpenCode TUI prompt as a VU-style time-series of generation speed:

```
tok/s ▃▆▇▇█▆▄ 42.0 ▲15% · avg 38.2 · pk 45.0 · ttft 0.8s
```

It shows live tokens per second, a recent speed graph, average and peak rate, trend, time to first token, and prompt-cache hit rate when the provider reports it. When a turn ends, the graph and totals freeze until the next turn.

This is a live speed meter, not a spending dashboard or long-term usage history.

Options (same keys for V1 and V2) include `vuColumns`, `vuScale`, `vuFullTps`, `slowTps`, `fastTps`, `showVu`, `showTrend`, `showAvg`, `showPeak`, `showTtft`, `showCache`, and `alwaysShow`. See the [README](https://github.com/jashjacob/opencode-token-metrics#options) for defaults.
